name: Void Song
body:
School evocation [cold]; Level bard 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range 15 ft.

Area cone-shaped burst
Duration instantaneous, see text
Saving Throw Fortitude partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You create a series of notes that call upon the utter cold atmosphere of the void between the stars. Any creature in the area takes 1d8 points of cold damage per caster level (maximum 5d8) and is staggered for 1 round as the air is sucked from their lungs. A successful Fortitude save halves the damage and negates the staggered condition. Creatures that do not breathe are not staggered.
